members.working:
Identify products:
(i) Cr³⁺ with excess NaOH → Cr(OH)₃ (or Cr(OH)₄⁻). Cr³⁺ is d³, three unpaired electrons → paramagnetic.
(ii) MnO₂ with O₂ and fusion with KOH in air → K₂MnO₄ (or MnO₄⁻). Mn⁴⁺ is d³, three unpaired electrons → paramagnetic.
(iii) HgCl₂ with excess KI → HgI₂ (Hg²⁺ d¹⁰) or Hg(l) complex; Hg²⁺ is d¹⁰, diamagnetic.
(iv) CuCO₃ heating → CuO (Cu²⁺ d⁹) → paramagnetic.
(v) ZnO with HCl → Zn²⁺ (d¹⁰) → diamagnetic.
Thus paramagnetic products in reactions (i), (ii), (iv) → 3 reactions.
